record.name: Vonage
record.one_liner: Vonage provides communications and messaging APIs for voice, video, messaging, and identity verification.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free developer account and receive free credit when opening an account.
record.api_note: The API covers voice, video, messaging, network features, and verification capabilities.

evidence.quote:
Verify API supports two types of authentication:

- JWT
We’ll give you some free credit when you first open your account and you can top up when you run low.
